description: Establish and record the green baseline on branch kiro/tv-release-hardening-0.8.2-001 before any change. Confirm the sandbox toolchain (JDK 17 via mise, Android SDK 35 at /opt/android-sdk, gradle on PATH) runs the existing gates and document exactly which gates run locally vs CI-only. This feature changes NO product code; it only verifies the pre-existing state so later regressions are attributable.
steps: Confirm branch is kiro/tv-release-hardening-0.8.2-001 (git branch --show-current) and HEAD baseline is 0b6f1f8398b49d352b9d0046f1bb020d537098e7 (git log -1 --format=%H).
Run the Python boundary tests: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`. Expect 12 tests OK. Record output.

Set env for all Gradle commands: `export ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=/opt/android-sdk JAVA_HOME=/root/.local/share/mise/installs/java/17.0.2`. gradle 8.14.5 is already on PATH via mise shims.
Run `gradle :app:assembleDebug :app:testDebugUnitTest --stacktrace` and confirm BUILD SUCCESSFUL and app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk is produced. Record output.

Run `gradle :app:lintDebug` once and observe the known IntelliJ/UAST MessageBusImpl 'Already disposed' failure under gradle 8.14.5. Then attempt to run lint under gradle 8.9 to qualify it locally: download gradle 8.9 (e.g. `curl -sS -o /tmp/gradle-8.9-bin.zip https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-8.9-bin.zip` then unzip to /opt/gradle-8.9) and run `/opt/gradle-8.9/gradle-8.9/bin/gradle :app:lintDebug --stacktrace`. If lint passes under 8.9, record it as LOCALLY QUALIFIED under gradle 8.9; if it still fails, record lint as CI-ONLY with the exact error class. Do NOT modify lint rules or suppress anything.

Run the two env-conditioned builds to prove both config paths compile: `SCENEVIBE_ENABLE_LAN_DEV=true gradle :app:assembleDebug` and `SCENEVIBE_CLOUD_ORIGIN=https://interface-scenevibe-3wxg.vercel.app gradle :app:assembleDebug`.

Write findings into this feature file documenting each gate result and the exact gradle version used for each. Do not commit yet beyond the already-created .agents/ task state (that is fine to commit).
acceptance_criteria: Python boundary tests pass (12 tests, OK).
gradle :app:assembleDebug and :app:testDebugUnitTest succeed locally with JDK 17 and Android SDK 35 and produce app-debug.apk.
LAN DEV and Cloud-origin assembleDebug variants both compile.
The lint gate status (locally-qualified under gradle 8.9 OR CI-only with its exact failure signature) is recorded in findings.
No product source, manifest, or test file is modified in this feature.
findings:
GREEN BASELINE ESTABLISHED. All existing gates exercised; no product source, manifest, or test file modified (verification-only). git status --porcelain shows only .agents/ task-state files (FEAT-001.json, task.json) plus an untracked, gitignored tests/__pycache__/.

BRANCH / BASELINE: git branch --show-current = kiro/tv-release-hardening-0.8.2-001 (correct). git log -1 --format=%H = 9877ff3b7f2818b1ff8d5a63bed6d4aac0213c13, whose message is 'chore(tv): add 0.8.2 release-hardening task plan'. Its parent is 0b6f1f8398b49d352b9d0046f1bb020d537098e7 ('Merge SceneVibe TV 0.8.1 recovery hardening') — the product-code baseline named in the briefing. HEAD 9877ff3 differs from the stated baseline ONLY by the .agents/ task-plan commit (no product/manifest/test changes), so the product tree under test is exactly the 0b6f1f8 baseline.

TOOLCHAIN: env set for every gradle call -> ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk, ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=/opt/android-sdk, JAVA_HOME=/root/.local/share/mise/installs/java/17.0.2 (JDK 17.0.2). Android SDK 35 (platform android-35, build-tools 35.0.0, platform-tools) at /opt/android-sdk. Network OPEN_INTERNET.

GATE RESULTS:
1) PYTHON BOUNDARY TESTS (local): `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` -> 'Ran 12 tests in 0.002s / OK'. PASS (12 tests).
2) ASSEMBLE + UNIT TESTS (local, gradle 8.14.5 on PATH via mise): `gradle :app:assembleDebug :app:testDebugUnitTest --stacktrace` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL (38 actionable tasks). Artifact confirmed: app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk (79039 bytes). PASS.
3) LINT under gradle 8.14.5 (local): `gradle :app:lintDebug --stacktrace` -> BUILD FAILED. Exact signature: com.intellij.serviceContainer.AlreadyDisposedException: MessageBus(... BusState$Disposed ...) at com.intellij.util.messages.impl.MessageBusImpl.checkBusDisposed, surfaced via java.lang.ExceptionInInitializerError in org.jetbrains.uast.UastFacade.<clinit> -> com.android.tools.lint.UastEnvironment$Companion.disposeApplicationEnvironment -> com.android.build.gradle.internal.lint.AndroidLintWorkAction$Companion.dispose. This is the known lint-runtime/Gradle-version incompatibility (NOT a code defect); no lint rule modified or suppressed.
4) LINT under gradle 8.9 (local qualification): downloaded https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-8.9-bin.zip (needed curl -L to follow redirect; size 136114148 bytes), unzipped to /opt/gradle-8.9/gradle-8.9. Ran `/opt/gradle-8.9/gradle-8.9/bin/gradle :app:lintDebug --stacktrace` with JAVA_HOME=17 -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 33s (27 tasks executed); 'Wrote HTML report to app/build/reports/lint-results-debug.html'. LINT = LOCALLY QUALIFIED under gradle 8.9 (it is CI-ONLY under gradle 8.14.5 due to the MessageBus 'Already disposed' error above). CI uses gradle 8.9, matching this qualification.
5) ENV-CONDITIONED BUILDS (local, gradle 8.14.5): `SCENEVIBE_ENABLE_LAN_DEV=true gradle :app:assembleDebug` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL. `SCENEVIBE_CLOUD_ORIGIN=https://interface-scenevibe-3wxg.vercel.app gradle :app:assembleDebug` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL. Both config paths compile.

CI-ONLY (not qualified locally, per context.json; NOT run here): signed-release production chain (needs the four GitHub signing secrets, absent locally), assembleRelease signature validation, and the Android 15 emulator smoke test (no emulator/AVD/KVM locally). Lint is additionally gradle-version-sensitive: green on gradle 8.9 (local + CI), red on gradle 8.14.5.

No secrets were generated, logged, or committed.
